statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-6860 affects Vert.x vertx-core 4.5.24 used by Spark 4.0.x. The vulnerability involves potential unbounded server-side SNI SslContext cache growth with possible resource-exhaustion and DoS impact. The advisory indicates affected versions 4.3.4 through 5.0.8, with no released fix version specified. Waiting for upstream Vert.x to release a patched version on the 4.5.x line that addresses this issue.

CVE-2026-6860 affects Vert.x vertx-core 4.5.24 used by Spark 4.0.x. The vulnerability involves potential unbounded server-side SNI SslContext cache growth with possible resource-exhaustion and DoS impact. The advisory indicates affected versions 4.3.4 through 5.0.8, with no released fix version specified. Waiting for upstream Vert.x to release a patched version on the 4.5.x line that addresses this issue.
No fix available. Affected range is >=4.5.0, <=4.5.25 with no fixed version yet. Waiting for upstream fix.

Potential unbounded server-side SNI SslContext cache growth in Vert.x TLS handling. No fix available yet. Affected versions 4.3.4 through 5.0.8. Mitigation: disable server-side SNI if not needed, avoid wildcard hostname mappings, apply connection rate limiting.

Potential unbounded server-side SNI SslContext cache growth in Vert.x TLS handling. No fix available yet. Affected versions 4.3.4 through 5.0.8. Mitigation: disable server-side SNI if not needed, avoid wildcard hostname mappings, apply connection rate limiting.

No upstream fix is available: the advisory marks every 4.5.x release up to and including 4.5.25 as affected with no fixed version. vertx-core@4.5.14 is pulled transitively by druid-kubernetes-overlord-extensions via the Fabric8 Kubernetes client. Remediation requires upstream Eclipse Vert.x to ship a fix and Druid to repin. Monitor eclipse-vertx/vert.x and apache/druid upstream.
